def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    sixes=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==6]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2,c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            if abs(r2-r1)==abs(c2-c1):
                dr=1 if r2>r1 else -1
                dc=1 if c2>c1 else -1
                for k in range(abs(r2-r1)+1): out[r1+dr*k][c1+dc*k]=1
    for r,c in sixes:
        rr,cc=r,c
        while rr>0 and cc>0: rr-=1;cc-=1
        while rr<h and cc<w: out[rr][cc]=6;rr+=1;cc+=1
    return out
PY

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    ones=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==1]
    sixes=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==6]
    # Join pairs of 1 markers by diagonal segments.
    for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(ones):
        for r2,c2 in ones[i+1:]:
            if abs(r2-r1)==abs(c2-c1):
                dr=1 if r2>r1 else -1; dc=1 if c2>c1 else -1
                for k in range(abs(r2-r1)+1):
                    out[r1+dr*k][c1+dc*k]=1
    # Extend 6s along their anti-diagonal only in the direction linking the 6s
    # into their common continuous pattern; clamp to the observed marker band.
    # Each 6 traces its full anti-diagonal, with only input-marker aligned lines active.
    for r,c in sixes:
        for rr in range(h):
            cc=c+r-rr
            if 0<=cc<w and rr>=r: out[rr][cc]=6
    return out
